result.topic_en: Coordinates of a point under rotation about two axes (with offsets a, b, a'), expressed in terms of angles h, M, N and distance ρ, then rearranged to isolate ρ terms.
result.transcription:
314
Drehung um zwei Axen
[Skizze: Strecken $a$, $b$, $\varrho$]
$x = \varrho \cos h \cos N + a - a' \sin h$
$y = \varrho(\cos M \sin N - \sin h \sin M \cos N) + b \cos M - a' \cos h \sin M$
$z = \varrho(\sin h \cos M \cos N + \sin M \sin N) + b \sin M + a' \cos h \cos M$

$y \cos M + z \sin M - b = \varrho \sin N$
$-y \sin M + z \cos M = \varrho \cos N \sin h + a' \cos h$
$x - a = \varrho \cos N \cos h - a' \sin h^2$

methods.what: Cartesian coordinates of a point after successive rotations about two axes with offsets
methods.quote:
$x = \varrho \cos h \cos N + a - a' \sin h$
$y = \varrho(\cos M \sin N - \sin h \sin M \cos N) + b \cos M - a' \cos h \sin M$
$z = \varrho(\sin h \cos M \cos N + \sin M \sin N) + b \sin M + a' \cos h \cos M$

methods.what: Inverse rotation (by angle M) to separate the coordinate equations
methods.quote:
$y \cos M + z \sin M - b = \varrho \sin N$
$-y \sin M + z \cos M = \varrho \cos N \sin h + a' \cos h$
$x - a = \varrho \cos N \cos h - a' \sin h^2$
